name: DRLVaultV3 permissionless swap uses manipulated spot quote
summary: The fixed-clone vault exposed swapToWETH to any caller and derived amountOutMinimum from a same-transaction quote of the pool being traded. The attacker moved that pool first, forced the vault to exchange 100,000 USDC for 0.000120518513556060 WETH, then reversed the manipulation.

loss.notes: Gross victim value lost before recoveries: receipt Transfer log 12 spends 100,000 USDC (6 decimals); log 11 returns 0.000120518513556060 WETH (18 decimals). The component records raw USDC spent but values only its uncompensated portion: 100000 - 0.000120518513556060 × 3600.626 = 99999.56605790661 USD. USDC uses par and WETH uses the pre-exploit Chainlink ETH/USD answer. Contemporaneous consideration is deducted; attacker financing, fees, builder payments and later recoveries are not. Full USDC/WETH outgoing-log history from clone creation through the exploit contains only this USDC payment.

ageReset.description: Clone basis: the vault clone pins its master and held the USDC inventory sold through the unguarded swap path.

sources.note: Verified deployed source retrieved from https://etherscan.io/address/0x8aa6b0e10bd6dbaf5159967f92f2e740afe2b4c3#code. Runtime identity and semantic inspection are documented in source-7.

Semantic review reproduced source-1 receipt and callTracer, source-4 creation callTracer, verified DRLVaultV3 source, and archive eth_getCode/eth_call/eth_getLogs. Source-4 CREATE from 0xcd29be25e0b021a9404c90e163bb20680e2cf032 creates the 45-byte EIP-1167 runtime 0x363d3d373d3d3d363d738aa6b0e10bd6dbaf5159967f92f2e740afe2b4c35af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3 and initializes it in the same transaction. Code is empty at 23767199; clone hash is 0xbb928e718a69d1aaff6671a9f91de2f50ca5ba3ed143af53a1b43191595ccfa2 at creation 23767200 and pre-exploit 23769386, and the master has the recorded hash at both endpoints. Verified master has no upgrade, DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT path; initialized is one-way and token/router/quoter addresses cannot subsequently change. Creation calldata and endpoint getters fix USDC/WETH, Uniswap QuoterV2 0x61ffe014ba17989e743c5f6cb21bf9697530b21e, SwapRouter02 0x68b3465833fb72a70ecdf485e0e4c7bd8665fc45, fee 100 and slippageBps 50. Fee can change only through addLiquidityALL, which emits PositionMinted; the complete vault log range [23767200,23769387] has only a deposit at 23767213 (0xba58ad38b66ecdc999599db83011d72d9248ec42189006332a941317919ee1e5). A slippage change cannot create this defect: every allowed value still uses the manipulated current quote. Clone basis reflects the initialized instance holding the victim inventory. The exploit calls selector 0xe747d9dc with 100000000000, delegates to the pinned master and receives 120518513556060 wei WETH. ERC-20 Transfer logs filtered by from=vault over the entire creation-to-exploit range show exactly one USDC outflow and no WETH outflow, establishing the first loss in this instance. No other artifact supplies a defective invariant: canonical quoter/router/pool execute their documented swaps; the missing independent price guard and unrestricted swap are in the master. USD loss deducts retained WETH consideration at source-8 price; no attacker inputs or recoveries are counted. Reproduce eth_call latestRoundData() selector 0xfeaf968c at Ethereum block 23769386: roundId 129127208515966881754, answer 360062600000 (decimals() at that block returns 8), startedAt 1762783464, updatedAt 1762783487, answeredInRound 129127208515966881754. This independent pre-exploit ETH/USD value prices WETH consideration at $3600.626; USDC is valued at par.
